tool.name: Hermes Agent
tool.description: Self-improving open-source agent with persistent memory, built-in cron and a gateway to 20+ chat apps; runs on a laptop, VPS or cloud sandbox.
strengths: Learns and reuses its own skills
Cron jobs deliver to any chat platform
7 terminal backends incl. Docker, SSH, Modal
tool.pricing: Free and open source; model and hosting costs are separate.
tool.practitionerNote: Use a container or remote sandbox backend with command approval on rather than the local terminal backend. Self-written skills and memory mean you should review what it has learned before trusting it with production credentials.

dataResidency.detail: Self-hosted; operator chooses where it runs (local, VPS, cloud sandbox). Model calls go to the configured provider.

deployment.detail: Self-hosted locally or on remote backends (Docker, SSH, Daytona, Singularity, Modal, Vercel Sandbox).

auditLogging.detail: Searchable session history and command approval; no dedicated audit log documented.

soc2.detail: Self-hosted open-source agent; SOC 2 applies to the operator's infrastructure, not the package.

iso27001.detail: Self-hosted open-source agent; ISO 27001 applies to the operator's ISMS, not the package.

iso42001.detail: Self-hosted open-source agent; ISO 42001 applies to the deploying organisation.

euAiAct.detail: Self-hosted open-source agent runtime, not an AI system placed on the market by the maintainer; obligations rest with the deployer.
